name: SPD2010 Touchscreen
description: The `spd2010` touchscreen platform supports the SPD2010 capacitive touch controller. It requires an [I²C bus](https://esphome.io/components/i2c/) and a [display](https://esphome.io/components/display/). The default calibration covers a 412×412 display.

config_entries.label: Update Interval
config_entries.description: Polling interval when no interrupt pin is configured. Defaults to `50ms`.

config_entries.label: Interrupt Pin
config_entries.description: The controller's interrupt pin. Must be an internal GPIO. When omitted, the controller is polled.

config_entries.label: Mode
config_entries.description: Pin mode flags (input / output / pullup / pulldown / open_drain). Combine flags as needed — e.g. input + pullup for a button pulled to VCC.

config_entries.label: Open Drain
config_entries.description: Set the open drain mode flag.

config_entries.label: Inverted
config_entries.description: Invert the logical level. ``true`` swaps high/low in software so an active-low button reads as active when grounded.

config_entries.label: Reset Pin
config_entries.description: The controller's active-low reset pin. GPIO expanders are supported. Omit this if the board handles touch reset.

config_entries.label: Mode
config_entries.description: Pin mode flags (input / output / pullup / pulldown / open_drain). Combine flags as needed — e.g. input + pullup for a button pulled to VCC.

config_entries.label: Open Drain
config_entries.description: Set the open drain mode flag.

config_entries.label: Inverted
config_entries.description: Invert the logical level. ``true`` swaps high/low in software so an active-low button reads as active when grounded.

config_entries.label: Calibration
config_entries.description: Defaults to `x_min: 0`, `x_max: 411`, `y_min: 0`, and `y_max: 411`. Override these values for other panel dimensions.
